sources.evidence: Cementos Progreso's current plants page identifies Planta San Gabriel in San Juan Sacatepéquez, Guatemala as a cement-production plant dedicated to producing clinker and hydraulic cements, with current cement production capacity stated on the page.
UNACEM's 2026-published ISO 37001 certificate identifies the Atocongo industrial plant in Lima and explicitly certifies manufacturing and commercialization of clinker and cement there.
UNACEM's current products page lists Atocongo Plant and its current cement portfolio, including Types I and V Portland cement and hydraulic cement types HS(MH)(R), (MH)(R), and GU.
INC's current product page states CPII-F32 Portland cement is obtained by joint grinding of clinker, gypsum, and limestone and is available for delivery at Vallemí.

INC's July 2025 official publication identifies Planta Industrial de Vallemí as one of its four current operating points; its 2024-2028 strategic plan states the institution's mission is cement production and identifies the industrial plants at Vallemí and Villeta.

INC's official 2024-2028 strategic-plan publication identifies the Vallemí and Villeta industrial plants and states a mission of producing quality cement with an objective of guaranteeing continuous, efficient, sustainable operation.
